Subject: New in Mystery at Amazon.com: "Fresh Kills" by Bill Loehfelm



 Dear Amazon.com Customer,


 As someone who participated in the Amazon Breakthrough Novel Award ( http://www.amazon.com/b/ref=pe_8968580_txt_1/?node=332264011 ), or has purchased mysteries ( http://www.amazon.com/b/ref=pe_8968580_txt_2/?node=18 ) or  fiction ( http://www.amazon.com/b/ref=pe_8968580_txt_3/?node=17 ) recently from Amazon.com, you may like to know that Fresh Kills ( http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/ref=pe_8968580_txt_4/?ASIN=0399155317 ) by New Orleans author (and New York City native) Bill Loehfelm is the winner! Read an exclusive Q&A and essay ( http://www.amazon.com/gp/feature.html/ref=pe_8968580_txt_5/?docId=1000215651 )  with the author, and check out early customer praise ( http://www.amazon.com/gp/product/ref=pe_8968580_txt_6/?ASIN=B00121WDJM ) for this gritty, hero-with-a-heart debut, praised by Publishers Weekly as "the next Dennis Lehane."
